## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `node --check darknode-legacy.js lib/*.js test/*.js` passes
- [ ] `node darknode-legacy.js --version` boots
- [ ] Pure logic added to `lib/` has a test in `test/run.js`
- [ ] No new dependencies; no emojis in code or user-facing output
- [ ] A new AI backend builds its flags only in `lib/engines.js` `args()`
